title: Version 17.12.8
body_markdown:
*Released May 13th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| A recent update to Visual Studio causes an app that worked well when built with previous VS versions to crash. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/A-recent-update-to-Visual-Studio-causes-/10808044) |
| Fixed an issue in the modern query work item TFVC checkin-policy that prevented the project name from being retrieved. Additionally, fixed an issue in the forbidden patterns TFVC check-in policy that caused the patterns to be "forgotten" by the policy after it was created. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/TFVC-Policies-Storage-Updates---not-work/10888692) |
| Address sanitizer in Release may introduce bugs | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Address-sanitizer-in-Release-may-introdu/10314256) |
| Incorrect code gen with /arch:SSE4.2 (generates incorrect insertps immediate) | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Incorrect-code-gen-with-arch:SSE42-ge/10876207) |
| Fixed the binding redirect for the System.Reflection.MetadataLoadContext assembly, allowing VS code and extensions to reference older versions of that assembly and still run properly in the devenv.exe process. |  |
| Fixed intermittent failures in the C++ language toolset that manifest as `D8000: UNKNOWN COMMAND LINE` errors | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/cl-:-command-line--error-D8000:-UNKNOWN-/10768403) |
| Fixed an issue to prevent re-ordering of AVX instruction onto SSE2-only execution path. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/_mm_cvtsi64_si128-gets-lowered-to-vmovq-/10834249) |
| Fixed context not supported error in Containers window. |  |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE |
| --- | --- |
| Access to ETW tracing not known by Admin installing VS on the machine | [**CVE-2025-32703**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-32703) |
| Remote Code Execution due to nuget package squatting | [**CVE-2025-32702**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-32702) |
| .NET - Spoofing - Elevation of Privilege in msbuild's DownloadFile tasks default behaviors | [**CVE-2025-26646**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-26646) |

Top bug fixes From the community
A recent update to Visual Studio causes an app that worked well when built with previous VS versions to crash. Feedback ticket
Fixed an issue in the modern query work item TFVC checkin-policy that prevented the project name from being retrieved. Additionally, fixed an issue in the forbidden patterns TFVC check-in policy that caused the patterns to be "forgotten" by the policy after it was created. Feedback ticket
Address sanitizer in Release may introduce bugs Feedback ticket
Incorrect code gen with /arch:SSE4.2 (generates incorrect insertps immediate) Feedback ticket
Fixed the binding redirect for the System.Reflection.MetadataLoadContext assembly, allowing VS code and extensions to reference older versions of that assembly and still run properly in the devenv.exe process.
Fixed intermittent failures in the C++ language toolset that manifest as D8000: UNKNOWN COMMAND LINE errors Feedback ticket
Fixed an issue to prevent re-ordering of AVX instruction onto SSE2-only execution path. Feedback ticket
Fixed context not supported error in Containers window.
Security advisories addressed CVE

Remote Code Execution due to nuget package squatting CVE-2025-32702
